newsitem.title: SPAIN: TENNIS-COSTA BEATS PIOLINE TO ENTER TOP 10.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-COSTA BEATS PIOLINE TO ENTER TOP 10.

text.p: Spain's Albert Costa will move into world top 10 for the first time next week after reaching the semifinals of the Barcelona Open with a comprehensive 6-4 6-2 win over Cedric Pioline on Friday.
Costa, who suffered two singles defeats in his country's recent Davis Cup debacle in Italy, coped better in difficult conditions after a stoppage for rain at 5-3 in the first set.
The Frenchman had beaten top seed Thomas Muster in the previous round but his resistance crumbled after he squandered two points to break back to 5-5 following the restart.
Costa will face the winner of the quarter-final between Andrei Medvedev and Spain's other top 10 player, Carlos Moya.
The other semifinal will feature either Albert Portas or Karim Alami and the winner of Fernando Meligeni's match with former French Open finalist Alberto Berasategui.
